diagnosis: Candidate/bad runs overrepresent repeated actions, especially repeated clicks, no-ops, and scrolling.
expected_mechanism: Detecting unchanged outcomes forces strategy changes instead of retry loops, improving progress while adding only small state-comparison and replanning costs.
policy_text: Before repeating an action, compare the latest observable state with the state before the previous attempt. If the action produced no relevant change, do not retry it unchanged; inspect the obstacle, alter the target or method, or stop and report the blocker.

quantitative_evidence.finding: Repeated operations have a net candidate/bad excess of 1,261, equal to 11.31% of the profile total (11,146). Within this excess, repeated click contributes +639, no-op +356, and scroll +277.
Individual candidate-side traces show the same action recurring across successive steps—for example, search clicks at steps 0006–0007 and buy-tickets clicks at steps 0007 and 0014–0018.
